title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Psalms 25: a prayer to be taught Yahweh's paths, forgiveness of the sins of youth and redemption for Israel.

questions.text: What does the psalmist lift up to Yahweh in the first verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 25:1 says, 'To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.'

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh to teach him in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, 'Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.'

questions.text: Which sins does the psalmist ask Yahweh not to remember?
questions.explanation: Psalms 25:7 says, 'Don't remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions.'

answers.text: The sins of his old age

questions.text: Because Yahweh is good and upright, whom will he instruct in the way?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says, 'Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.'

questions.text: Why does the psalmist say his iniquity needs pardon in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Psalms 25:11 says, 'Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.'

answers.text: Because it was done in ignorance

questions.text: What will the offspring of the man who fears Yahweh do?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says, 'His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.'

questions.text: With whom is the friendship of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 25:14 says, 'The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him.'

questions.text: Out of what will Yahweh pluck the psalmist's feet?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says, 'My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.'

questions.text: With what kind of hatred do the psalmist's enemies hate him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 25:19 says, 'They hate me with cruel hatred.'

questions.text: Whom does the last verse ask God to redeem out of all his troubles?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says, 'Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.'
